messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The configuration of 13 points maximizing the minimum triangle area is an affine-regular hexagonal arrangement, consisting of a centered axis-aligned hexagonal lattice of 6 points at coordinates (0.5±1/3, 0.5±1/3), (0.5±2/3, 0.5), and (0.5, 0.5±2/3), surrounded by 6 boundary points placed at the midpoints of each side and each corner: (0.5±1/2, 0), (0, 0.5±1/2), (0.5±1/2, 1), and (1, 0.5±1/2). This configuration achieves a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/36, and no configuration of 13 points in the unit square can achieve a strictly larger minimum area due to a pigeonhole argument partitioning the square into 36 equal cells of side 1/6, where any triangle with all three vertices in a single cell or in a collinear triple of adjacent cells has area at most 1/36."}
